mapper.select: SELECT stat.album_id, max(if(stat.stat_type = '0401', stat_num, 0)) playStatNum, max(if(stat.stat_type = '0402', stat_num, 0)) subscribeStatNum, max(if(stat.stat_type = '0403', stat_num, 0)) buyStatNum, max(if(stat.stat_type = '0404', stat_num, 0)) commentStatNum FROM album_stat stat WHERE stat.album_id=#{albumId} and stat.is_deleted=0
